why: Abstract (opened) lists 13 treatments on P. aculeata seed including GA3 at 100, 250 and 500 ppm and 0.2% KNO3, alone and with leaching, against a distilled-water control (15% germination), but reports only that treatments differed (p<0.01) and that leaching, scarification and hot water gave the highest germination.
